goal: Verify whether maritime freight carriers are mandated to lodge annual audited financial returns within 120 days of fiscal year end.
successCriteria: Review statutory updates for maritime regulatory filing deadlines.

evidence.passage: Statutory Instrument 2026/41: Article 88 is repealed; maritime operators must lodge returns within 60 days of fiscal year end, superseding the former 120-day allowance.

proposedAnswer: Maritime freight carriers are mandated to lodge annual audited financial returns within 120 days of fiscal year end.
